scope: Fresh registered native boundary integration artifact inspection on synthetic fixtures. No production admission, physically independent custody, historical-time or complete hypothesis-platform qualification.

requirements.requirement: Actual server-issued and idempotent marker epoch/xid/binding/registration, with committed issuance before capture.
Exact two-table per-binding publication and next-transaction contiguous capture; preserve open revisions, intervening transactions and rollback safety.
Typed native-frame decoder, immutable exact delivery, and complete bootstrap/page validation before both prepare and advance.

Independently configured custody pin, current head, request scope and exclusion across awaits; exact unchanged identity forwarding, with trusted-adapter and physical-custody assumptions distinguished.
Source-fenced prepare/advance/retry and receipt rollback, lost acknowledgement, slot loss/recreation, external movement and revocation behavior.
Least privilege and v2-to-v1 downgrade denial/private implementation revokes while legitimate v1 works; actual lock-owner tests and retained failure fixes.

Actual named-log and tree evidence with honest limits: synthetic shared physical custody, no distributed atomicity, wall-clock history, production, provisioning, scheduler, retention SLA or full hypothesis certification.

candidate_files.content:
# Registered native boundary integration v2 — isolated candidate

This candidate adds an actual source-authorized marker issuance, source capture, independently retained delivery, custody-bound permit preparation and native advancement path. It is synthetic qualification only; production admission and a physically independent custodian are not configured.

The original v1 SQL implementation bodies are retained under private names; public incarnation wrappers now reject explicitly registered v2 bindings before delegating legitimate v1 calls. This prevents fallback after publication downgrade. Legitimate v1 contracts remain unchanged. The additive 022 uses separate entrypoints, a registered exact two-table publication contract, per-binding marker filter, and the existing immutable capture/permit/checkpoint chain primitives. Version-two registrations explicitly pin the contract digest. The fixture forwards all incarnation and contract arguments unchanged to source SQL.

The source assigns marker epoch/xid and admits only the currently authorized binding and incarnation. A marker issuance transaction must commit before capture; capture consumes the next published transaction, including preceding revision transactions, without skipping. Marker tuples are matched to the committed source issue. The consumer retains and reads back the complete source transcript and typed delivery, validates the full bootstrap evidence, and advances through current external custody and source authority. All historical_time_qualified fields remain false.

Source and external journal fixtures are separately authenticated capabilities but share the disposable PostgreSQL physical restore domain. This is NOT physical independence. No real source identity, production credentials, deployment or live Supabase changes are authorized by these tests.

Implementation/verification status: initial testable remote increment. Hosted native/golden results must be inspected before freezing. Additional adversarial cases and failures will be retained in GitHub history. The final report must distinguish proven native integration from remaining production custody, provisioning, retention/scheduling and independent audit gates.

Custody assumptions: the admitted journal is append-only and durable, with current readback; the source-scoped custody authority excludes registration replacement and credential revocation across awaited source operations. The consumer revalidates every bootstrap page and its manifest/hash immediately before prepare and again before advance. Preflight alone is not claimed as permanent retention. A backend permitting deletion/corruption during those authority-fenced operations is not an admissible custodian; the disposable fixture does not establish physically independent storage.

Readback checks do not create a distributed transaction. Arbitrary concurrent rollback or disappearance in another store between the final check and native source effect cannot be prevented by these checks alone. Admitted custody must supply durable append-only storage and exclusion for its failure/revocation model; physically independent custody remains a real-activation requirement. Tests include missing and corrupt paged bootstrap evidence after successful prepare and require that advancement is never called.

Native lock-order qualification observes the exact active outer custody transaction PID as the revocation blocker while the inner source gateway transaction is held. PostgreSQL may wait on that earlier shared authority holder first. The source commit gate, exact source receipt readback, and reverse-order zero-checkpoint denial remain mandatory; an arbitrary waiting connection is not evidence.

name: Golden regression suite

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      # G-ALG-0 added a real runtime dependency (graphology); the suite no
      # longer runs on zero node_modules, so npm ci is required first.
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Dependency audit (triage report)
        if: matrix.node == 24
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm audit --json

name: Hypothesis durable worker isolation
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'supabase/qualification/hypothesis-assessments/**'
      - 'supabase/qualification/mip-cutover-authority/**'
      - 'supabase/functions/source-comparison-generation-candidate/**'
      - 'src/lib/hypothesisAssessment*.js'
      - 'verifier/hypothesis-worker/**'
      - 'tests/hypothesisAuthProviderFixture.mjs'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - '.github/workflows/hypothesis-worker.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.6
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: mip-disposable-ci-only
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Install locked verifier dependencies without package scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit
      - name: Pull isolated worker runtime
        run: docker pull node:24-alpine
      - name: Enable metadata decoding in the existing disposable service
        env:
          MIP_DISPOSABLE_POSTGRES: comparison-qualification
          MIP_POSTGRES_SERVICE_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node verifier/hypothesis-worker/prepareLogical.mjs
      - name: Synthetic native authority and actual worker restart tests
        env:
          MIP_DISPOSABLE_POSTGRES: comparison-qualification
          MIP_POSTGRES_SERVICE_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 verifier/hypothesis-worker/*.test.mjs

name: Hypothesis PostgreSQL concurrency
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'supabase/qualification/hypothesis-assessments/**'
      - 'verifier/hypothesisPostgresConcurrency.py'
      - 'tests/hypothesisAssessmentFixture.mjs'
      - 'supabase/migrations/**'
      - '.github/workflows/hypothesis-postgres.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  hypothesis:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.6
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: mip-disposable-ci-only
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Qualify bound hypothesis acceptance and process loss
        env:
          MIP_DISPOSABLE_POSTGRES: comparison-qualification
        run: python3 -B verifier/hypothesisPostgresConcurrency.py

failure_disposition.cause: Initial022 SQL dollar delimiter generation defect; fixed before subsequent native execution.
Catalog regclass name resolution required schema USAGE; replaced with catalog OID lookup, no new grant.
Document reserved uppercase vocabulary token; text corrected without weakening tests.

Wrong expected blocker PID caused reverse-lock test failure; missing cleanup leaked held transaction and produced cascading lock timeouts. Workflow eventually timed out; no implementation-requested cancellation.
Same pre-diagnostic reverse-lock orchestration retained; not used as qualification.

Cleanup fixed cascade. Exact failures: expected wrong source PID instead of outer custody blocker; two tests expected digit-containing error truncated by existing sanitizer.208 observes exact active custody PID and renames only own SQL error.

limitations: Synthetic fixtures share one physical PostgreSQL restore domain; no physically independent custody is established.
Full readback is not a distributed transaction. Admitted journal requires crash durability, append-only retention and exclusion under its declared failure/revocation model.
No production deployment, provisioning, scheduler/housekeeping cadence, operational retention SLA or live source credentials have been configured.
No historical wall-clock qualification follows from a committed marker WAL endpoint.
Independent Cursor review and reconciliation of parent-managed prior audit changes remain outstanding.
